Hi Marcus / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency and cost numbers look promising for our clinical summarization use case. The partnership team here discussed pursuing the AWS ACE co-sell path so we can get credits and a co-selling motion with the AWS field.

Could you:  
- initiate ACE registration and loop in your PDM/PSM with the AWS contacts?  
- share a short mutual operating plan (MOP) template and a procurement checklist so our legal/procurement team knows the gating items?

I'll also pull in procurement on the thread once I have the initial scope. Our timeline target for pilot kickoff is mid-Jan.

Thanks,
Tom Hsu
Director, Platform Partnerships
AcmeHealth

Appreciate the note and the clarity on timeline. I'll kick off ACE registration and bring in our AWS PDM/PSM. Marissa, can you lead the registration and coordinate PDM intro? Kimberly, please add procurement-readiness artifacts (procurement checklist + sample SOW) and a one-page MOP draft.

2) Intro call with AWS PDM/PSM + Acme stakeholders (technical + procurement) — target next week if possible.  
3) Share MOP draft + procurement checklist for Acme review.

- Pilot scope and success metrics (10–15 min)

We can join Tue 11/14 at 10:00 PT. Tom, please confirm attendees and we'll send a calendar invite.

Best regards,
Sara Bloom
